selected_rules.rule_answer: Left three cards are red, right three are black
Two different ranks each appear at least twice
Every card is an even number (2, 4, 6, 8, or 10 — no face cards)
Every card is an odd number (3, 5, 7, or 9 — no face cards)
The sequence of ranks reads the same forwards and backwards
The rank sequence of the right half matches the left half exactly
First card is black, and all black cards precede all red cards
Three consecutive positions contain ranks that form a run of 3 (e.g., 5, 6, 7 in any order)
The sequence of colors reads the same forwards and backwards
Suits form 3 adjacent bracket pairs: each pair is either Spades-Clubs or Hearts-Diamonds (every opener is immediately closed)
